name: boj_get_jgb_yield
description:
Japanese interest rates by term, in percent, monthly, from FRED (OECD series): 10y is the 10-year JGB yield (IRLTLT01JPM156N), 3m the 3-month interbank rate (IR3TIB01JPM156N).
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): bond_term (10y or 3m; default 10y); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For the call money rate use boj_get_policy_rate. FRED series need FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); without it they fail with a message saying so.
Example: {"bond_term": "10y", "start_date": "2024-01-01"}

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given

series_code.description: FRED series code (e.g., 'IRLTLT01JPM156N' for the 10-year JGB yield)

value.description: JGB yield percentage (null if not available)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Japanese Government Bond yields across the yield curve. Critical for understanding Japanese monetary policy and global fixed income markets.
